idea-plugin.name: TimeRail
idea-plugin.description:
TimeRail — Visual branching code history for IntelliJ IDEA.

Snapshot your editor state at any moment and restore it with one click. Snapshots are displayed in an interactive branching tree so you can see exactly how your work evolved and jump back to any point in time.


Features:
  • 📸 Capture editor snapshots (all open tabs) with a single click
  • 🌿 Branching history tree — every restore creates a new branch
  • 🔍 Zoomable tree view with +/− zoom controls
  • 🖼️ Screenshot thumbnails for each snapshot
  • ⚡ One-click restore to any past state

Requires Java 21.
